correctness.rationale: For any positive periodic orbit, multiplication of exact ratios forces every c_i=q a_i+p b_i to be {p,q}-smooth with product (pq)^L. Valuation updates give c_next-c=q(u-1)+p(v-1). Below pq, c=p or q exits positivity and every other smooth c<pq (a higher power of p) increases; at or above pq, the range is forward invariant, including the pure q-power case via q^v-q+p(v-1)>=q^2-q+p>=pq. Therefore a periodic orbit cannot contain c<pq; the product forces all c=pq and all n fixed. Modular reduction solves q a+p b=pq. The derivation covers all primes and periods; numerical checks are independent supplementary regression.
